title: thymus bracteosus subsp. bracteatus
intro: Thymus bracteosus subsp. bracteatus, commonly known as Creeping Thyme or Spanish Thyme, is a flowering plant species that belongs to the family Lamiaceae. It is valued for its medicinal properties, which offer potential health benefits such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial effects, contributing to its use in traditional medicine to alleviate respiratory issues and promote wound healing. The therapeutic actions of Thymus bracteosus subsp. bracteatus include stimulating the nervous system and acting as an expectorant, while its bioactive constituents include essential oils, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties. The plant's bioactive compounds also exhibit anti-cancer and anti-microbial properties, suggesting its potential use in the development of new pharmaceuticals and natural remedies.
